LanguageData.ShinAndMang_ShinGizmoDescription: Manifest Shin (心), strengthening the body.\n\nCosts {0} mood. Only lasts while drafted.
LanguageData.ShinAndMang_TaughtShinText: {0} has taught {1} the art of Shin (心). Mastering it will take a lifetime.
LanguageData.ShinAndMang_LearnedShinText:
{0} has learned the art of Shin (心). Their Shin (心) has taken the form of {1}.

Using Shin (心):
- Manifest it while drafted, at a cost in mood. It ends when undrafted or downed.
- It strengthens the body and holds back the user's single worst emotional burden while active.

Growing in mastery:
- Mastery grows above all in real combat with Shin (心) active, and faster the more emotional the fight: fighting on while badly wounded, in deep despair or fury, or as allies fall.
- More experienced Shin (心) users can share tips with those behind them.
- Each rank is harder to reach than the last. Greater mastery strengthens Shin (心), steadies the mind, and allows more rings of Mang (望).
LanguageData.ShinAndMang_CannotLearnShin: Only adults capable of strong emotion can learn Shin (心).
LanguageData.ShinAndMang_Fate_Effect: - Wounds fuel this Shin (心): currently +{0} damage and +{1} pain shock threshold, growing as health falls.\n- Against those with lower mood: +1% damage per 2% mood difference, up to +{2}.
